description: The plot illustrates average repetition rate across relation categories for three conditions, with horizontal dotted lines indicating the overall average repetition rate for each condition. The x-axis is labeled “Relation Category,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer categories from 0 to about 65 with tick labels shown at regular intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis is labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 up to about 0.6 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.1 increments. Three solid lines with small point markers are shown: a blue line with circular markers (legend text partially obscured) fluctuates widely, starting near 0.25 at category 0, peaking around 0.60 at category 1, dropping to roughly 0.06 by category 3, showing another prominent peak near 0.43 around category 22 and the highest spike near 0.62 around category 31, then varying mostly between about 0.08 and 0.25 toward the end and finishing near 0.05 around category 65; an orange line with triangular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” varies between roughly 0.05 and 0.47, beginning near 0.15 at category 0, rising to about 0.32 at category 1, dipping near 0.07 at category 3, reaching a major peak near 0.58 around category 31 and another high point around 0.47 near category 47, and ending around 0.16 near category 65; a green line with triangular markers labeled “DPO” stays lower and smoother, starting near 0.12 at category 0, rising to about 0.29 at category 1, dropping to around 0.06 at category 3, then oscillating mostly between about 0.05 and 0.18 through the remaining categories and ending near 0.06 at category 65. Three horizontal dotted average lines are drawn: a blue dotted line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo” at approximately 0.163, an orange dotted line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” at approximately 0.227, and a green dotted line labeled “Average of DPO” at approximately 0.117, with these numeric values also annotated near the left side of the plot in matching colors.
